text:
olivia: quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. we agreed on three action buckets: scheduler defaults, quota backstops, and a concise headroom playbook. assign owners + short timelines and keep updates brief in this thread.

marcus: i'll own scheduler defaults (A-sched). plan: 24h trace replay -> small knob sweep for preemption/backfill -> PR with conservative defaults. target draft: 2025-06-10.

sam (oncall): include a 5-step smoke test we can run during surge sims. i can run the sim on 2025-06-11 evening.

kevin: i'll take quota backstop (A-quota). proposal: soft per-team burst quotas with a grace window, then reroute to reserved pool when breached. draft card + mapping by 2025-06-02.

olivia: i'll write the headroom playbook (A-headroom): 1-page checklist, escalation contacts, and an alert at 9% headroom. draft by 2025-05-30.

marcus: sample config i'll test:
```
scheduler:
  preemption:
    deadline_ms: 45000
  backfill:
    window_sec: 20
```

sam (oncall): please post the smoke test steps on the board and tag @oncall so we can validate. also include KV cache persistence checks.

kevin: posted the quota CSV to the board: https://redwood.internal/boards/gpu-capacity/cards/99. @product-infra please review by 2025-06-03.

olivia: ops-bot, create a recurring weekly check for 6 weeks on Thursdays 08:30 PT and invite owners.

ops-bot: created event "GPU capacity remediation check" weekly on Thursdays 08:30 PT, invites sent to olivia, marcus, kevin, sam (oncall). link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/evt/11234

marcus: brief owners recap: A-sched marcus  2025-06-10; A-quota kevin  2025-06-02; A-headroom olivia  2025-05-30. will post PR and perf charts when ready.

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-28) kevin: quota draft up on the board, requesting infra/product feedback.

(narrow follow-up 2025-05-29) olivia: headroom playbook draft published; alert wired to staging.

(narrow follow-up 2025-06-09) marcus: PR opened with benchmark graphs, requesting quick review.
